With Section 6 Of The Pocso Act vs In Re: Sajid Bin Amjad on 12
November, 2024
 12.11.2024
 Sl. No.5
 akd
 [Adjourned]
 C. R. M. (A) 3725 of 2024
 In Re: An application for anticipatory bail under Secti
 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed on 01.10
 connection with Narendrapur Police Station Case No.73 o
 18.01.2024 under Section 376(2)(f)(n)(3) of the Indian 
 with Section 6 of the Pocso Act.

And
 In Re: Sajid Bin Amjad
 ... .
 Mr. Sandipan Ganguly .. Sr. Advocate
 Mr. Sourav Chatterjee
 Mr. D. Dinda
 Ms. Ankita Bose
 ... ... for the petiti
 Ms. Anasuya Sinha .. ld. Addl. Public Prosecutor
 Mrs. Manasi Roy
 ... ... for the State

1.
Learned Advocate for the State seeks time to verify the documents relied upon by the petitioner.
She also submits the mobile phone of the petitioner could not be seized as he was not arrested.
2. Petitioner is directed to hand over his mobile phone to the Investigating Agency by tomorrow and necessary investigation with regard to the electronic data shall be undertaken.
Report in this regard be filed on the adjourned day.

3. Let the matter appear under the same heading on 19.11.2024.
4. Subject to compliance of the aforesaid direction, petitioner shall not be arrested for a period of two weeks from date or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.) Signed By : ARUP KUMAR DAS High Court of Calcutta 13 th of November 2024 04:55:05 PM Signed By : ARUP KUMAR DAS High Court of Calcutta 13 th
